1. Come to Vietnam
2. Eat here.
3. Enjoy the rest of Vietnam

Excellent intimate and tasty restaurant
Jul 2026 • Couples
Excellent restaurant serving revisited Vietnamese cuisine in a well-kept, cute, and welcoming environment. Duck and tropical fruit salad is delicious, caramelized pork skewers are excellent, as are the meat and rolls. Dessert to finish was very tasty and appreciated. Impeccable, precise, and attentive service. Highly recommended
